text:
Maya R.: nightly-eval alert: model/nightly-2026-03-20 had a spike in failures on instruction+code prompts — 12 regressions flagged.

eval-bot: nightly-evals: model/nightly-2026-03-20 failed 12/120 prompts; regression tag: tokenizer-change

Arjun K.: digging in — BLEU/Rouge drops concentrated on prompts with inline code and special tokens (e.g., '<|tab|>', '<|nl|>').

Sylvia L.: I ran a token-id diff after the tokenizer merge. Looks like several token ids shifted; some multi-char tokens became split.

Maya R.: attaching a couple quick samples we flagged:

```text
Input:
"Fix the bug in the following C snippet:\
int main(){ printf(\"%d\", x); }"
Expected (stable-20260214): returns a patched snippet with proper format.
Model/nightly-2026-03-20 output:
"Fix the bug in the following C snippet:\
int main(){ pr int f(\"%d\", x); }"

Note: 'printf' token got split into 'pr','int','f' which broke downstream heuristics.
```

Jon P.: can we reproduce locally with the quantized build? try: `./scripts/eval_prompt_set --model nightly-2026-03-20 --subset codegen`

Arjun K.: repro confirmed on my devbox with the same tokenization. Also seen in a couple language instruction prompts where prefix matching fails.

Maya R.: immediate playbook: 1) quarantine the nightly model, 2) revert tokenizer merge in canary routing, 3) run full token-id audit.

Jen S.: ops: I'll pin routing to stable-20260214 and block canary until triage complete.

ci-bot: routing-change: set model.route.default -> stable-20260214 by Jen S. (CI job queued)

Sylvia L.: follow-ups: 1) regenerate vocab->id mapping, 2) add deterministic token id migration step to tokenizer merges, 3) add a unit test that asserts no id shifts for existing token subsets.

Arjun K.: I'll script a tokenization diff that outputs top-affected prompts and token-id histograms.

Maya R.: also check embedding/kv caches — id changes can corrupt cached embeddings. Add cache flush in rollback plan.

Jen S.: started rollback and cache flush. ETA ~15m; will post when done.

Maya R.: thanks — moving this thread to the regression-triage doc. Creating issue: ml/tokenizer-id-shift-#542. :raised_hands:
